note: The strip run (frames.mjs --every 0.5 --shutter 0.35 --samples 4) wrote its 307 thumbnails and 10 strips and was then killed from outside (no output, no report). This file was rebuilt by a helper: frames from the thumbnails on disk (samples not recorded per frame), timing = mean of 12 seeks across the film with the same accumulation (samples_at_sample lists the sample count of each), purity as frames.mjs does it.
